verdict.rationale: Mastra's pricing docs mention enterprise-tier 'RBAC, SSO, IAM, and network policy integration,' which gestures at access-control capabilities, but there is no concrete documentation of a mechanism for issuing scoped or least-privilege API credentials specifically to an agent (e.g., per-tool key scoping, credential minting for agent runs). missing for 10: explicit docs/API for generating scoped/least-privilege credentials for agents, examples of credential scoping in tool execution, independent verification of RBAC/IAM enforcement.
